hint: Dividing by a power of ten makes the number smaller. Which way does the decimal point move, and how many places?

hints.text: Dividing by a power of ten makes the number smaller. Which way does the decimal point move, and how many places?
$1{,}000$ has three zeros, so move the decimal point three places to the left, starting from the end of $4500$.
The point moves from $4500$ to $450$, then $45$, then $4.5$, so $4{,}500 \div 1{,}000 = 4.5$.

explanation: Since $1{,}000 = 10^3$, dividing by it shifts the decimal point three places to the left.
Start with the point at the end of $4500$. One shift gives $450$, two shifts give $45$ and three shifts give $4.5$.
So $4{,}500 \div 1{,}000 = 4.5$, which fits because $4{,}500$ is four and a half thousands.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check by multiplying back
steps: $4.5 \times 1{,}000$ shifts the point three places right.
